reconciliation_notes:
Both verifiers independently recommend GOLD with high trust and dispute only the four non-load-bearing estimate fields (hbm_line_bytes, hbm_energy_pj_per_byte, hbm_energy_pj_per_byte_wr, energy_pj_per_mac). All load-bearing fields per the spec (bandwidth, capacity, device peak / per-instance MAC, instances, clock) are GOLD with two independent sources each, so by the tie-break rule (twin = lowest load-bearing field) the twin is GOLD.

Load-bearing GOLD, retained as authored: hbm_bandwidth_bps=2.048e11 (Meta blog + ServeTheHome/Hot Chips), hbm_capacity_bytes=137438953472 (128 GiB LPDDR5), onchip_sram_capacity_bytes=268435456 (256 MB; ServeTheHome '256 GB' is a confirmed typo), onchip_sram_bw_bps=2.7e12, device_peak_flops_bf16=1.77e14, compute_instances=64, per_instance_mac_s=1.383e12, clock_hz=1.35e9, tdp_w=90. Internal consistency holds: 64 PE x 1.383e12 MAC/s x 2 FLOP = 1.77e14 = 177 TFLOPS dense BF16.

Key caveat carried into arch_note and mem_standard: the backing tier is LPDDR5, NOT HBM. The field is kept named/role='hbm' only for experiment-schema compatibility (experiment reads bandwidth_bps/capacity_bytes); mem_standard='lpddr5' records the truth. This is the architecturally load-bearing distinction for MTIA v2 — ~16x lower backing BW than an H100 HBM3 stack at comparable capacity means the 256 MB on-chip SRAM (2.7 TB/s) carries reuse and there is no HBM-style spill cliff of the same magnitude; this is a deliberate capacity-bound recommendation-inference design, not a defect.

Disputed fields kept but held at BRONZE (both verifiers agree 'not disclosed'): hbm_line_bytes=32, hbm_energy_pj_per_byte=8.0, _wr=10.0, energy_pj_per_mac=0.5 — all labeled provenance_type=estimate. matrix_unit=[32,32,1] downgraded to SILVER: it reproduces per_instance_mac_s and device peak exactly (1024 MAC/cyc x 1.35 GHz = 1.382e12) but is cross-validated, not vendor-stated; note the DPE physically has two 32x32 MAC tiles per PE (that second tile maps to the INT8 2x / sparse path, not the dense-BF16 rate used here). die_area_mm2=421 and pe_local_mem_bw_bps=1.0e12 kept at SILVER per verifier.

hbm_energy_pj_per_byte rd=8.0 / wr=10.0 — LPDDR5 access energy not disclosed by Meta; generic estimates, BRONZE (write>read asymmetry assumed)
energy_pj_per_mac=0.5 — not vendor-published; N5 estimate, BRONZE
pe_local_mem_bw_bps=1.0e12 — source ambiguous whether 1 TB/s is per-PE or aggregate; modeled per-PE (x64), SILVER
matrix_unit geometry — DPE has two 32x32 MAC tiles per PE; [32,32,1] reproduces the dense-BF16 rate but exact per-cycle tile utilization for BF16 vs INT8/sparse not vendor-specified, SILVER
